verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Appwrite ships an MCP server and CLI so external AI agents/tools can interact with its API and docs (appwrite-docs-11, appwrite-docs-31, appwrite-probe-3, appwrite-probe-6), but this is for third-party AI clients connecting to Appwrite, not an AI assistant embedded within the Appwrite dashboard itself that can write queries, debug errors, or explain the backend inline. No documentation or probe evidence describes such an in-dashboard chat/assistant feature.
